messages:
Aisha (AE): Ripcord asked for a 3-week POC to migrate off CompetitorX. Main asks: streaming + function-call parity, token cost delta, and a security questionnaire. Need SE + SRE to estimate effort.

Ben (SE): I can lead the shim work. Request: 150-200 sanitized sample requests (stream frames + function calls) and expected acceptance criteria (semantic threshold or human pass-rate).

Dana (Presales): They'll require SAML, SCIM, IP allowlist, audit logs, and a DPA. They'll send the questionnaire after NDA.

Chao (SRE): Quick infra note: hosted supports IP allowlist + audit logs. Client cert auth or VPC peering => Dedicated/Private. I'll provision staging IPs once NDA is in.

Ben (SE): Parity approach: map CompetitorX `passages` -> Redwood `messages`; translate function args and rewrap streaming deltas back to their line-delimited frames. Smoke test script will be posted to S3.

Aisha (AE): Pricing: estimated 1M tokens/day. Finance: please provide ballpark hosted vs dedicated buckets. Which is preferred for the pitch?

Chao (SRE): If they need cert pinning or VPC peering, push Dedicated. Otherwise hosted with enterprise add-ons is faster.

infra-bot: env created: ripcord-poc-stg. Upload: s3://redwood-pocs/ripcord-ripcord/ (restricted). Ephemeral keys issued.

LegalBot: NDA required before they upload any logs. Please attach the questionnaire here after NDA.

Ben (SE): Plan: run side-by-side for 48h to measure token delta, produce a small eval (embedding cosine + human spot-check). Will prep shim prototype and smoke curl: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are concise."}],"stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions`.

Aisha (AE): Owners: Ben (SE) POC lead, Chao (SRE) infra, Dana presales + questionnaire, Aisha customer coord. Kickoff Monday. Post blockers here.
